Gift Card & Membership Questions

  • At Xing, online on this page or at our Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout and Brookfield salons. Choose an occasion card or a value card, add a personal message, and we deliver it instantly on WhatsApp or email, or as a printed card.

  • You prepay once and we add 10% to 25% bonus value depending on your tier. Use the balance for eligible hair, skin and nail services at any Xing salon until it expires. Our team confirms your tier value and eligible services on WhatsApp or at the salon before you pay, so there are no surprises.

  • Most clients choose Xing Gold: 18% bonus value, 12-month validity, priority weekend slots and sharing with one family member. Choose Privé for maximum value and family sharing, or Glow if you are trying membership for the first time and visit a little less often.

  • Yes, gift cards and memberships work at all three Xing salons in Bangalore. Use them at Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield for eligible hair, skin and nail services, and switch between salons whenever it suits you. We confirm the details with you before every service starts.

  • A Xing gift card is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued. The person you gift it to can book any time in that year at Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield, and our team confirms every detail with them before the service starts.

  • Yes. We send a personalised e-card with your message on WhatsApp or email, on the date you choose. You can also collect a printed card at any Xing salon. Just share the recipient’s name and the delivery date in the form, and our team confirms everything with you on WhatsApp.

  • Yes. For 10 or more cards we add your company logo to the e-card and provide a single invoice. Your team can use their cards at any of our three Bangalore salons, and we deliver every e-card on WhatsApp or email on the date you choose.

  • Gold covers one family member and Privé covers two, registered at purchase. Glow is for the member only. Family members use the same balance at any Xing salon in Bangalore, so a parent, partner or sibling can book their own hair, skin and nail services.

  • Our “For Amma” gift card: hair spa, pedicure and a relaxing head massage at a Xing salon near her. She can visit Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield, and we deliver the card with your personal message on WhatsApp, by email or as a printed card.

  • A gift card is for gifting someone else; membership is for yourself and saves the most if you visit once a month or more. Membership adds 10% to 25% bonus value to every visit, while a gift card comes with an occasion perk and a personal message.

Gift Card & Membership Terms

  • Gift cards are valid for 12 months from the date of issue. Memberships are valid for 6 months (Glow) or 12 months (Gold and Privé) from the date of activation.

  • Bonus value applies to salon services only, not to retail products.

  • Gift cards and memberships are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash.

  • Gift cards and memberships cannot be combined with other offers or packages.

  • A lost e-card is reissued to the registered phone number.

  • Gold covers one family member and Privé two. Each family member’s name is registered at purchase.

  • Festival gift cards and perks are valid only within the stated festival window.
